services.name: Kayak Rentals
services.desc: Here’s your chance to take in some of the most breathtaking scenery of the Niagara River. Join one of our experienced tour guides as you paddle your kayak through marshes and around islands that played a pivotal role in the settlement of the Niagara Frontier. See the boyhood home of former U.S. President Grover

services.name: Kayak and Stand Up Paddle Board Rentals

gap: Price for kayak and paddle board rentals not stated
blurb: Guests can rent individual or tandem sit-in or sit-on kayaks and stand up paddle boards for a minimum of 2 hours to explore the Upper Niagara River on their own. The marina also offers full service boat repair, seasonal dockage, boat sales, and winter storage. Located on Grand Island, NY, between Buffalo and Niagara Falls.
